title: Color issues
text: Color issues. This is green if I ever saw green. Gray no way. It is also a bit odd in that it zips the looooong way along the side instead of at the top. The fabric is odd. I haven't washed it yet to see how it will wear. It took 3 weeks to arrive. i should have stuck with Target.
